## File: facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/data/samplers/distributed_sampler.py

```
['create a TrainingSampler to produce an infinite stream of shuffled training indices across distributed workers', 'create a RandomSubsetTrainingSampler to sample a random subset of training indices for accuracy estimation', 'create a RepeatFactorTrainingSampler to handle class-imbalanced datasets with repeat factors based on category frequency', 'create an InferenceSampler to split inference indices evenly across all distributed workers', 'build repeat factors from category frequency for class-imbalanced datasets like LVIS']
```

